raw_output:
alias: 晚上九点后客厅温度调节
description: 晚上九点后如果客厅温度低于17度且窗户关闭，开启空调并设置为22度
triggers:
  - platform: time
    at: '21:00'
conditions:
  - condition: and
    conditions:
      - condition: device_state
        device_id: living_window
        entity_id: binary_sensor.living_window
        state: 'off'
      - condition: device_state
        device_id: living_ac
        entity_id: climate.living_ac
        attribute: current_temperature
        value_template: "{{ value | float < 17 }}"
actions:
  - service: climate.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
    data:
      temperature: 22
mode: single
